card.name: Linking words before CYP enzyme names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "by" right before a CYP enzyme name (CYP3A4, CYP450) in drug interaction text, e.g. "inhibitors of" or "metabolized by". Also an opening parenthesis before a chemical formula.

modes.label: Before CYP enzymes
modes.description: "of" or "by" after inhibitor, inhibition or metabolized, where a CYP enzyme name comes next.

modes.label: Before a chemical formula
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or similar word right before a chemical formula starting with C.
